Hi Alice — great, thanks for the numbers — that's helpful. Below is a concise mapping of options and a ballpark unit-econ example. I've attached our pricing PDF for more detail.

Licensing / pricing models (private/VPC):
- Option A: Annual license + per-node capacity fee. One-time platform license + per-GPU node monthly fee. Predictable for capacity planning; good for committed deployments.
- Option B: Hybrid commitment: annual committed token volume (discounted $/1M tokens) + overage billing. Useful if you want unit pricing tied to usage but with predictability.
- Option C: Fully usage-based (metered tokens) — higher $/1M but lower upfront. Less predictable at scale.

Support tiers (examples):
- Standard: Business hours support, best-effort SLA, quarterly reviews.
- Premium: 24x7 incident response, P1 1-hour SLA, dedicated CSM, quarterly security reviews and annual on-site (or virtual) runbook review.
- Managed: Premium + optional managed ops add-on (Redwood handles day-to-day infra ops for VPC).

Ballpark unit economics for your numbers (350M tokens/mo = ~4.2B tokens/year):
- Hybrid (Option B) example: Commit 3B tokens/yr at $900 per 1M tokens => ~ $2,700,000 for committed usage (pro-rated). Add annual license/infra fees and support.
- Annual license + per-node model (Option A): e.g., $150k annual platform license + $X per GPU node/month (we'll size nodes based on your 220 QPS peak). With 4 environments (2 prod, staging, dev) we typically size dedicated prod clusters and smaller staging/dev; this influences node counts.

Questions for you (so we can prepare a formal proposal and SOW):
- Can you confirm target committed tokens per year if you prefer the hybrid model? (e.g., 3B vs 4B )
- Confirm total environment count that needs HA (you listed 2 prod clusters + staging + dev = 4). Do both prod clusters need full HA & reserved capacity?
- Any mandatory compliance add-ons (e.g., audit log retention beyond standard 1 year)?

Next steps
- If the hybrid model looks interesting, we'll run a quick sizing call (30 mins) with Ben (technical) to translate QPS -> node counts and produce a per-node quote.
- I've attached redwood_private_pricing_v1.pdf with sample configurations.

Thanks — I'll hold on prep until you confirm committed volume and env HA requirements.

Best,
